Learning Hub

Networking, Streams & Security Curriculum

Master foundational networking, full-duplex streams, and modern cryptographic protocols to level up your skills.

Level 1

Web Foundations

HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, headers, status codes, RESTful methods, and request-response lifecycles.

Level 2

Real-Time Streams

WebSocket TCP upgrades, framing protocols, WebRTC SDP offer/answer handshakes, and ICE candidate negotiation.

Level 3

Security & Encryption

Symmetric AES-256 vs Asymmetric RSA, TLS 1.3 handshake verification, and DTLS-SRTP audio security.

Level 4

Distributed Edge Architecture

High-concurrency asyncio architecture, event streams, and zero-trust edge infrastructure.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about setting up groups, voice rooms, and learning tracks.

Is Connecto completely free?
Yes, 100%. All messaging, WebRTC voice channels, cybersecurity curriculum, and community features are completely free with zero subscription paywalls or hidden fees.
How secure are my voice and text communications?
All HTTP and WebSocket traffic runs over strict TLS 1.3 encryption. Voice calls utilize peer-to-peer WebRTC mesh encrypted with 256-bit DTLS-SRTP, ensuring your conversations are directly transmitted between participants without centralized audio recording.
What is the Learning Hub?
The Learning Hub is an integrated educational space designed to teach real-world computer networking, web protocols, and cryptography. Through visual modules and interactive milestones, members level up their practical skills from fundamentals to advanced architecture.
Does Connecto have a mobile app?
Yes! Connecto is available as an official native Android app (v4.2.1, 54 MB) engineered with Pure Black OLED aesthetics, Connecto Vault biometric & device screen lock, low-latency WebSockets chat, touch-scroll isolation gesture engine, and WebRTC mesh voice lounges. You can download the direct APK immediately by clicking any APK button or visiting /download/apk. It is verified and optimized for Android 7.0 (Nougat) all the way through Android 16+ (including Xiaomi / POCO HyperOS).

🛡️ Privacy & Security Charter

1. Zero Data Selling: Connecto does not monetize, sell, or rent your communications or contact information to third-party ad brokers.

2. End-to-End Cryptography: WebSockets channels operate over TLS 1.3 encryption and WebRTC voice lounges utilize 256-bit DTLS-SRTP peer-to-peer encryption.

3. Right to Anonymity: You can purge or anonymize your user profile at any time directly through the Settings panel.

4. Local Storage: Preferences like themes and sound toggles are safely stored on your local browser.

📜 Community Terms of Service

1. Community Respect: Harassment, hate speech, spamming, and illegal content distribution are strictly prohibited.

2. Educational Fair Use: Cybersecurity learning labs & CTF challenges must only be used for defensive learning and authorized security practice.

3. Account Integrity: Each member is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials and session tokens.
